metadata.description: Verify updateTag is exported from next/cache

part.text: `updateTag` exists — unlike `revalidateTag` (stale-while-revalidate), it expires the cache immediately, guaranteeing fresh reads on the next request.

Created `app/actions.ts` with a `createPost` Server Action using **`updateTag`** (not `revalidateTag`).

`revalidateTag` marks data as stale but may still serve the stale entry while revalidating in the background. `updateTag` expires the tagged cache entries immediately, so the next page load must wait for fresh data — guaranteeing no stale content. Typecheck passes.
